description.zh: 审核服务需要的参数集。taskId，即要查询的检测任务的taskId，每次支持输入一个taskId。
description.en: The parameter set required by the moderation service. taskId specifies the taskId of the moderation task to query. Only one taskId can be specified per request.

title.zh: 查询视频审核任务结果

descriptions.zh: 该接口不计费，建议您将查询间隔设置为30秒（即在提交异步检测任务30秒后查询结果），最长不能超出24小时，否则结果将会自动删除。
descriptions.en: This operation is not billed. Set the polling interval to 30 seconds (query results 30 seconds after submitting the asynchronous moderation task). The maximum query window is 24 hours. After that, results are automatically deleted.
